purpose: Teach: 英単語/地中海/フック/麓/猟/カウントダウン/詩集/強風

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、英単語、毎日、覚えるのって、結構、大変なんだけど、頑張ってる、私、葵、応援、お願いね、本気で、絶対、続けるからね、約束、葵にも、伝えておきたいから、本当に。
lines.en: Aoi, learning English words every day is actually really tough, but I'm working at it — please cheer me on. I'm serious about this. I'm going to keep going no matter what. That's a promise. I wanted you to know that.
lines.style: Soft opening with quiet determination. Voice fills with sincerity as she leans into her commitment. Steady pace, no rush. Slight vulnerable catch before 'promise' — she's asking for something that matters. Trails off tenderly at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。次の休み、地中海風の料理、葵で、家族と、楽しみたいわよ、本当に、美味しいレストラン、教えてもらったの、メイちゃん、一緒に、行きたい?絶対、楽しいよ、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah. For our next break, I'm thinking of trying some Mediterranean place with my family — there's this amazing restaurant someone told me about. Mei, would you want to come along? It's going to be so good, I promise.
lines.style: Warm, inviting energy from the start. Quick bright rhythm that pulls the listener in. Leans forward on the question — genuinely hoping for a yes. Ends with solid, friendly reassurance. Voice stays open and generous throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: カラオケで、最近、フックの利いた、曲、彼が、教えてくれたの、葵、本当に、メロディー、頭から、離れないのよ、絶対、おすすめ、メイちゃんも、聞いてみて、本当に、いい曲。
lines.en: Karaoke — this song my boyfriend showed me lately has been stuck in my head. It's got such a good hook to it, Aoi. You really have to hear it. Seriously, it's such a good song.
lines.style: Animated opening. Quick, conversational pace. Light excitement in the early words, settling into genuine recommendation. A small soft landing on 'really' — not pushing, just believing she's found something worth sharing. Intimate and unguarded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度の山旅行、富士の麓まで、家族で、行く予定なの、葵で、お弁当、用意してあげるからね、本当に、楽しみよ、本気で、絶対、メイちゃんも、いつか、行きたいよね、絶対。
lines.en: We're planning a trip up to the base of Mount Fuji with my family next time we get a chance. I'll make us a packed lunch for it — it's going to be so good. You should come with us someday, Mei. I mean it.
lines.style: Steady warmth from the start. Moves with natural ease through the plan, then softens noticeably when inviting Mei. Genuine care underneath — not performing hospitality, offering it. Ends with quiet certainty, like she's already imagining them together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昔の人、本当に、狩猟、で、生活していたのよね、葵、興味深いよね、メイちゃん、博物館で、特集、見てきたよ、本当に、面白かったわ、本気で、絶対、お勧めだよ、葵にも。
lines.en: You know, people in the old days actually lived by hunting — it's kind of fascinating when you think about it. I went to see this museum exhibit about it and it was really something. I'd really recommend checking it out, Aoi.
lines.style: Contemplative, thoughtful opening. Slower pace — she's inviting the listener into reflection with her. Warm curiosity in the voice. Picks up gentle momentum as she recommends. Doesn't demand agreement, just wants to share something that moved her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 年末のカウントダウン、葵で、特別イベント、考えてるのよ、メイちゃん、彼と、絶対、来てね、楽しい時間、約束するわよ、本気で、絶対、本当に、待ってる、お願い、本当に、来てね、本気。
lines.en: I'm putting together a special event for New Year's Eve at the café. Mei, you have to come — bring your boyfriend. I'm promising you it'll be amazing. Please come. I really mean it.
lines.style: Energetic opening with a note of real excitement. Builds warmth as she extends the invitation, then becomes more earnest when she asks directly. Steady conviction underneath the brightness — this matters to her. The final 'please' carries genuine wanting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、私、最近、詩集、読み始めたのよ、彼に、影響されてるかもね、本気で、心が、洗われる感じが、するの、葵にも、本気で、お勧めしたいよ、絶対、感動するよ、本当に、いい本。
lines.en: I've started reading poetry collections lately, and my boyfriend's kind of gotten me into them. There's something about it — it feels like it washes your heart clean. I really want to recommend it to you, Aoi. It's moving. It's a really good book.
lines.style: Soft, almost reverent opening. Gentle pace that respects the subject matter. Quiet wonder as she describes the feeling. Picks up slightly when recommending — genuine enthusiasm but never loud. Ends with tender certainty. Voice stays intimate throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今日、強風で、自転車、こぐの、本当に、大変だったのよ、メイちゃん、お互いに、気をつけようね、本気で、絶対、安全、第一に、しないと、ね、本当に、絶対、約束しようね。
lines.en: Today was rough with that wind — pedaling my bike was honestly a nightmare. Mei, we should both be more careful, okay? Let's promise each other to put safety first. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Concerned but not panicked opening. Conversational weight — she's not overreacting, just being real. Softens into care when addressing Mei directly. Steady, protective tone. Ends with quiet firmness — not bossy, just someone who cares asking for a commitment back.
